artikel.title: Tip: your items
artikel.body: Every purchase grouped under its canonical name. Search with operators (»eggs -organic«), press F for search, C for the category search. Filter by account at the top, and by category + date range (with total spend) via the sliders icon. Select several → subscribe to offers, avoid, set category/member.
artikel.bodyMobile: Every purchase grouped under its canonical name. Search with operators (»eggs -organic«). Filter by account at the top and by category + date range (with total spend) via the sliders icon, plus subscribed and avoided items. Tap several → subscribe to offers, avoid, set category/member.

articleEdit.title: Tip: editing an item
articleEdit.body: The canonical name is already selected – just start typing. »Apply to all« propagates name + category to all matching items. Quantity / unit price / total compute from each other.

offers.title: Tip: offers
offers.body: Real flyer deals for the items you subscribed to appear here (via Marktguru, by ZIP). Hit »Fetch offers« to refresh now. Subscribe to items from the Items list via »Subscribe to offers«.

receipts.title: Tip: receipts
receipts.body: Filter by account, store and source. The green + button adds a cash/card purchase directly – photo optional, the rest runs in the background.

receiptDetail.title: Tip: fast entry
receiptDetail.body: Use ↑/↓ to move through items (green outline), Enter opens the item with the canonical name focused. Drag the handle to reorder. When the item sum matches the receipt total, it flashes green.
receiptDetail.bodyMobile: Tap an item to edit it – the canonical name is focused right away. Use the copy icon to duplicate, the thin line between two items to insert a new one, and the grip to reorder. When the item sum matches the receipt total, the screen flashes green.

queue.title: Tip: review queue
queue.body: Uncertain AI proposals for product names. Search with the F key, sort by confidence/date. Select several and approve/reject them at once via the bottom bar — great for fast cleanup.

queue.title: Verification queue
queue.rejected: Proposal dismissed — won't be suggested again

units.title: Review units
units.intro: VDS suggested a fitting unit from the purchase history (variable weight → kg, constant pack → piece, drink → bottle/can). Apply it or keep the current one.
units.mixedIntro: These products were recorded sometimes with, sometimes without, or with different units. “Normalize” sets every position with no unit or a count unit to the chosen unit (weight/volume lines like “400 g” stay untouched) and adopts it as the base price unit.
units.mixedAccepted: Discrepancy accepted – won't be shown again

admin.title: Admin

integrations.title: Connect VDS
integrations.intro: How to wire up external sources:
integrations.mailboxBody: Each person connects their own mailbox in Profile. Forwarded or incoming invoices/order confirmations are filed as receipts automatically.
integrations.smtpBody: Set up in the SMTP section so VDS can send notifications (offers, shared shopping lists) by email.
integrations.offersBody: Work with no setup — fetched daily automatically and announced by email/push. Address & categories in the Household section refine the matches.

admin.usernameDerivedHint: Username is auto-generated from the email.
admin.youUseProfileForReset: Change your own password via Profile
admin.cannotDeleteSelf: You can't delete your own account
admin.linkNotEmailed: Email could not be sent — share this link manually:
admin.canWriteHint: Write access – off = read-only (can't change or delete anything)
admin.seesAllKonten: Sees all accounts (super-admin) — can view every receipt, not just GKK + own
admin.kontenHint: Payment accounts. GKK is shared (everyone sees it). Personal accounts belong to a user and are only visible to them (+ super-admins). Every receipt belongs to exactly one account.
admin.kontoHasReceipts: Account still has receipts — move them first
admin.dataHint: Super-admin only. Overview across all accounts + data export.
admin.backupHint: Downloads ONE archive (.tar.gz) with a full database dump AND every receipt photo — really everything. Keep it safe. With many receipts the file can get large.
admin.maintenanceHint: Background AI jobs: categorize new items, clean up canonical names, fetch store logos.
admin.runAfterOcrHint: Runs a churn pass right after a receipt is scanned (debounced), instead of waiting for the nightly run. Cleans up new receipts immediately.
admin.dropfolderHint: Watches a folder: every PDF or image dropped there is treated like an e-mail invoice (vision OCR → receipt). For invoices you pull manually from a vendor portal (e.g. Strato). Deduplicated by file content — your originals stay put.
admin.aiTasksHint: Each task uses a provider + model. You can switch per task (e.g. cheap model for simple classification, strong one for vision OCR).
admin.taskRecategorizeDesc: Assigns each item to a category path (e.g. "Food/Fruit/Bananas"). Closed vocabulary — only the defined categories.
admin.taskChurnerStage1Desc: Cleans canonical product names from OCR noise ("BIO BANANE" → "Bananas"). Decides: known name, new name, or web search needed.
admin.taskChurnerStage2Desc: Only invoked when Stage 1 says "web search". Reads SearXNG hits and proposes a name.
admin.taskOcrDesc: Reads receipt photos and extracts date, store, total, and all line items. Used by the "Re-OCR" button on a receipt and by the batch reimport.
admin.taskCategoriesChatDesc: The chat assistant on the categories page that designs a category structure with you.
admin.usageHint: Consumption per provider, model and task. Local models (Ollama) are free; for Anthropic/DeepSeek you get a rough cost estimate and a top-up link.
admin.notifHint: Global switches per notification type and channel.
admin.offersHint: Household address, nearby-offer search, extra offer-only categories and the avoid list.
admin.avoidListHint: Products you no longer want to buy. Receipts containing them are flagged, and they're kept out of shopping suggestions.
admin.avoidListEmpty: No items on the avoid list yet.
admin.supermarketInfoHint: Fetches branch opening hours via OpenStreetMap (near the household address). Runs automatically every night; manually entered hours are left untouched. Leaflets & offers to follow.
admin.taskModelReviewDesc: Every 2 weeks judges whether better models exist. Can itself be a local model.
admin.taskBankmatchDesc: Creative second pass on "Re-match": links open bank bookings to receipts/income/fixed costs the deterministic matcher misses. Suggestions only (⭐), approved by you. Needs a strong reasoning model.
admin.taskStatsaskDesc: Turns a question in Statistik (e.g. "how much for fuel in 2026") into filters — a category or article group + date range + accounts. The AI never states a number; the app computes everything deterministically. Small, structured task → a cheap model is plenty.
admin.reviewHint: Every 2 weeks the reviewer model proposes, per AI task, both an API/cloud and an open-weight model (price/performance aware). The email lets you apply all-API or all-open-weight — or reject. Nothing is switched automatically.
admin.offerRadiusHint: Will later auto-search offer leaflets from stores within this radius — even stores you never shop at.
admin.offerCategoriesHint: Extra categories you only want for offers (e.g. garden furniture, tools) — not part of the normal product categories.
admin.offersNote: Offers are fetched daily from Marktguru automatically (no API key needed) and announced by email/push. Address, radius & categories refine the matches.
admin.confidenceHint: Suggestions below the threshold go to the review queue instead of being auto-applied.
admin.fetchIconsHint: Fetches missing store logos and product images via SearXNG web image search (no LLM, so no model dropdown). Runs in the background (~1-2 min).

welcome.title: Welcome to Vorratsdatenspeicher
welcome.body:
VDS reads your receipts with AI, understands what you bought, and turns it into your spending analysis, pantry, matching offers and smart shopping lists.

Let's get you set up in a few steps — you can change everything later in Admin.

lang.title: Language
lang.body: Which language would you like to use VDS in? Changeable anytime in your profile.

ai.title: AI & search
ai.body: VDS reads receipts with AI (OCR) and classifies products, plus web search for new products & offers. Enter your providers' credentials — green = reachable, red = unreachable. You need at least one provider (Anthropic recommended).

household.title: Your household
household.body: For local offers and showing your nearest branch we need your address. Optional — you can set it later.

family.title: Who's in the household?
family.body: Add people to attribute consumption and spending. Pick an emoji by clicking. Optional.

konten.title: Accounts
konten.body: Accounts group spending — e.g. a shared household account or cash per person. A household account already exists (name & type editable). Optionally add more.

models.title: AI models per task
models.body: Fine-tuning: which model for which task. The default is usually fine — local tasks use Ollama, demanding ones use Claude. Changeable anytime in Admin.

categories.title: Category detail level
categories.body: How fine-grained should your spending categories be? VDS then designs the tree with you via AI.
categories.hint: Just a preset — you build the actual category tree later in the Categories area with the AI, anytime.

email.title: Send email (SMTP)
email.body: So VDS can email shopping lists & offers. Optional.

imap.title: Email import (IMAP)
imap.body: VDS can pull receipts automatically from your mailbox (e.g. forwarded PDF invoices). Optional — your mailbox, password stored encrypted.

done.title: Done — all set!
done.body: Upload your first receipt now. VDS detects items, prices and the store automatically, and the rest follows. Enjoy!

scan.title: Scan your first receipt
scan.body:
This is where Vorratsdatenspeicher starts. Snap a photo of a supermarket receipt and the AI reads the store, the date and every single item for you — no typing.

Only from your first scan does VDS learn where you shop and what you buy. Everything else — your stats, pantry, offers and shopping lists — grows from your receipts.

categoriesAdmin.title: Item categories
categoriesAdmin.subtitle: Design your category structure with AI and re-sort your items
categoriesAdmin.linkHint: Restructure categories via AI chat, edit the tree, recategorize items
categoriesAdmin.chatEmpty: Describe how your categories should look — e.g. "I want groceries broken down in more detail, separate drugstore and household, plus a hobby category". The AI knows your real items.
categoriesAdmin.treeHint: Drag to move · double-click to rename · max 3 levels
categoriesAdmin.applyConfirm: The entire category catalog will be replaced (Meta categories are kept). Items keep their old paths until they're recategorized. Continue?
categoriesAdmin.applyHint: "Apply categories" replaces the catalog. Then click "Recategorize all items" so the AI sorts every item into the new structure.
categoriesAdmin.applied: {{count}} categories saved. {{orphans}} items now have stale paths — please recategorize.
